mapper.select:
select id, member_id, name, description, img_url, img_arr, category_ids, address_name, longitude, latitude,
ROUND(st_distance_sphere(point(#{longitude},#{latitude}),point(IFNULL(longitude,0), IFNULL(latitude,0)))) distance,
address, status, publish_status, reason, del_flag, start_date, end_date, template_id, topic_id, club_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, (select t.product_type from cms_topic t where t.id = cms_activity.topic_id) as product_type from cms_activity
status = 1 and publish_status = 1 and del_flag = 0 and cancel_time is null and and (club_id is null or club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id = cms_activity.club_id and active_club.del_flag = 0 )) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic parent_topic left join club parent_club on parent_club.id = parent_topic.club_id and parent_club.del_flag = 0 where parent_topic.id = cms_activity.topic_id and parent_topic.club_id is not null and parent_topic.club_id != 0 and parent_club.id is null ) and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and FIND_IN_SET(#{categoryIds}, category_ids) > 0 and address_name like concat('%', #{addressName}, '%') and topic_id = #{topicId}
and exists (select 1 from cms_topic filter_topic where filter_topic.id = cms_activity.topic_id and filter_topic.product_type = #{productType})
and start_date <= now() and end_date >= now()
and start_date > now()
and (club_id is null or club_id = 0) and id in (select data_id from cms_activity_like where member_id=#{isLikedMemberId}) and start_date >= #{startDate} and end_date > now()
and ROUND(st_distance_sphere(point(#{longitude},#{latitude}),point(IFNULL(longitude,0), IFNULL(latitude,0)))) < #{distanceMeters}
order by distance, create_time desc
